attributes.note: Coachmen's features page names the 2.0L Turbo I4 diesel and the 9-speed automatic and lists the AWD chassis as an option on all floor plans; the 208 hp / 332 lb-ft output figures are Mercedes-Benz's ratings for this engine, carried over from the October 14, 2026 record.
attributes.value: RWD standard, AWD optional on all floor plans; 2.0L Turbo I4 diesel, 208 hp / 332 lb-ft, 9-speed automatic

attributes.note: Coachmen publishes no MSRP for the Galleria. The displayed $236,822 is the dealer MSRP on a 2026 24QM listed by General RV Center, recorded October 14, 2026 and re-corroborated October 16, 2026 in the same live listing; it is labeled a dealer listing wherever it appears. Stickers on the current floor plans run higher (a 2026 24FL at $240,810, a 2026 24A at $255,756, 2026 24RB units to $271,962), and advertised sale prices run $70,000 to $105,000 below sticker across the line.
Coachmen's published spec tables list no sleeping capacity; dealer spec tables rate every Galleria floor plan at 2.

attributes.value: Wet bath with sink and shower; porcelain flush toilet to a black tank on every floor plan (no cassette toilet)

attributes.note: 26 gal on all four floor plans (24A, 24FL, 24Q, 24RB), per Coachmen's own specification page for each floor plan.
Coachmen's specification pages list interior height as 74 inches.

attributes.value: 330 Ah AGM standard; optional 640 Ah Lithionics lithium system with internal heater, second under-hood alternator and 3,000W inverter/charger (deletes the Onan generator)
2,000W Victron pure sine inverter (3,000W on lithium models)
R-15 insulation standard, R-38 reflective insulation in the floor; Truma Combi Eco Plus heat and hot water; optional Cozy Wrap insulation and Polar Package Plus tank heating pads

conflicts.note: The October 14, 2026 ledger recorded 27 gal from an RVUSA dealer spec block for a 2026 24QM. Coachmen's own specification pages list 26 gal for every current floor plan. Logged October 16, 2026.
conflicts.resolution: Resolved by policy (Mark, Oct 14, 2026): where sources disagree, the manufacturer's published figure is authoritative for display. The manufacturer figure (26 gal) is displayed and the disagreement stays logged.

name: Galleria
notes: Current lineup re-verified October 16, 2026 on coachmenrv.com: 24A, 24FL, 24Q and 24RB (the 24T and 24QM no longer appear as current floor plans on Coachmen's site, though 2026 24QM units remain in dealer stock and provide the price reference). Platform specs are uniform across the four floor plans (170in wheelbase, GVWR 11,030 lb, 24' 3in long, 26 gal fresh, 24 gal fuel); gray water is 24 gal except the 24RB at 26, and black water varies by floor plan (12 to 26 gal), so every Galleria has a flush toilet and a black tank and none has a cassette. Fresh water was upgraded from the dealer-only 27 gal recorded October 14, 2026 to Coachmen's 26 gal (conflict logged). Coachmen publishes no MSRP and no sleeping capacity or wet-bath dimensions in its spec tables; the price displayed is a dealer MSRP reference (see the startingPrice note) and sleeping capacity is dealer-rated at 2. No Galleria warranty figure was verified from a manufacturer source, so none is published.
